learning_outcomes.text: Acquire a rational questioning approach within the framework of a practice related to human work.
Acquire a data collection methodology adapted to this questioning.
Appropriate knowledge related to a practice connected to human work.
Bring together "practices" and "theories" based on the professional experience of apprentice engineers (in conjunction with practice analysis sessions).
Transform this knowledge into professional know-how.

teaching_methods: interventions related to various domains of human work
research conducted for three years based on a professional situation from the apprentice's host company (resulting in a thesis)
individualized follow-up with a module intervenor (for questioning, structuring research, and correcting deliverables and the thesis)
degree: Diplôme d'ingénieur Centrale Nantes, spécialité Mécanique (apprentissage)
